下，宋朝军民进行了顽强抵抗，遏制了金兵南侵，最终双方订立和议，以淮河至大散关（今陕西宝鸡西南）一线为界，形成了宋金长期对峙的局面，历史上就把这段时间称为宋室的“中兴”。 宋室南渡之后，朝中将领以张俊、韩世忠、刘光世、岳飞战功最为卓著，他们在抵抗金兵、保证南宋政权的建立与巩固过程中起过重大作用，被誉为“中兴四将”，这幅《中兴四将图》就是对四人形象的描绘。图中自右向左依次为刘光世、韩世忠、张俊、岳飞。 据史书记载，刘光世一贯畏惧金军，一有诏令让他到前线，他就设法退避。由于他治军不严，不少流寇、叛军反而投靠他，他的部队在当时人数众多，成为高宗依靠的主力部队之一，他死后被追封鄜王。由于名声不好，在“中兴四将”的另一种说法中，刘光世被名将刘锜替代。 韩世忠，18岁就应募入乡兵。北宋

context.en: This story concerns Sun Yat-sen’s provisional presidency during the republican transition.
context.zh: 本条讲述共和转型中孙中山出任临时大总统。

title.en: 1911–1912: from empire to republic

summary.en: The Wuchang uprising opened a revolutionary crisis in which provinces withdrew their allegiance from the Qing court. Overseas Chinese networks, reform campaigns and military politics had helped create the conditions for change. Sun Yat-sen became provisional president, and negotiations with Yuan Shikai accompanied the emperor’s abdication. Ending the dynasty did not immediately create a stable unified republic. The new political order faced regional military power and disagreements about reform. This turning point is best read as the beginning of a prolonged struggle over citizenship, government and national authority rather than a single completed transition.
summary.zh: 武昌起义引发革命危机，各省陆续脱离清廷。海外华人网络、改革运动和军队政治共同构成变化背景。孙中山出任临时大总统，与袁世凯的协商伴随皇帝退位。王朝结束并未立即带来稳定统一的共和国，地方军事势力与改革分歧仍然存在。这是关于公民身份、政府制度和国家权威的长期斗争的重要转折。

dateNote.en: October 1911 uprising through February 1912 abdication; the pin marks Wuchang, not every revolutionary centre.
dateNote.zh: 从1911年10月起义至1912年2月退位；武昌仅代表其中一处革命中心。

sourceSupport.quote:
In 1874-75, the Russian government sent a research and trading mission to China to seek out new overland routes to the Chinese market, report on prospects for increased commerce and locations for consulates and factories, and gather information about the Dungan Revolt then raging in parts of western China. Led by Lieutenant Colonel Iulian A. Sosnovskii of the army General Staff, the nine-man mission included a topographer, Captain Matusovskii; a scientific officer, Dr. Pavel Iakovlevich Piasetskii; Chinese and Russian interpreters; three non-commissioned Cossack soldiers; and the mission photographer, Adolf Erazmovich Boiarskii. The mission proceeded from Saint Petersburg to Shanghai via Ulan Bator (Mongolia), Beijing, and Tianjin, and then followed a route along the Yangtze River, along the Great Silk Road through the Hami oasis, to Lake Zaysan, back to Russia. Boiarskii took some 200 photographs, which constitute a unique resource for the study of China in this period. Most of the photographs are included in this album, which later became part of the Thereza Christina Maria Collection assembled by Emperor Pedro II of Brazil and given by him to the National Library of Brazil.

context.en: This story concerns Carver’s practical agricultural teaching at Tuskegee.
context.zh: 本条讲述卡弗在塔斯基吉开展实用农业教学。

title.en: Tuskegee’s demonstration wagon · Agricultural science beyond the campus
title.zh: 塔斯基吉示范车 · 校园之外的农业科学

location.label: Tuskegee, Alabama; representative teaching, research and agricultural-demonstration centre, not a surveyed wagon route

summary.en:
In 1906 George Washington Carver designed a mobile demonstration laboratory for Tuskegee’s agricultural teaching. The wagon addressed a practical problem: research centred on a college could not help poorer farmers simply by remaining on campus or circulating technical claims beyond their means. Demonstration offered another way to connect knowledge with cultivation and household work.

Tuskegee’s account places the wagon alongside free, plainly written brochures on crops, cultivation and nutritious meals. Farmers were encouraged to submit soil and water for analysis; instruction also addressed livestock care and preserving food. Alternatives to cotton, including legumes, connected decisions about crops to concerns about land and nutrition. These were related activities rather than a single miraculous invention.

The mobile laboratory made teaching portable, but its design alone does not establish who attended, how consistently advice was adopted or whether incomes rose. Nor was Carver the sole person through whom agricultural knowledge moved. Teachers, demonstrators and farming households had to interpret and adapt it. This entry dates the wagon’s design while leaving the wider history of Tuskegee’s extension staff and later programmes open for further research.
summary.zh:
1906年，乔治·华盛顿·卡弗为塔斯基吉农业教学设计移动示范实验室。示范车回应一个实际问题：以学院为中心的研究，若只留在校园，或提出超出贫困农户资源条件的技术主张，就不能帮助他们。示范提供另一种把知识同耕作、家庭劳动连接的方式。

塔斯基吉的介绍把示范车与免费、通俗的作物、种植和营养饮食资料并列。农民被鼓励提交土壤及水样分析；教学还涉及牲畜照料及食物保存。包括豆科作物在内的棉花替代作物，把种植决策同土地、营养问题联系起来。这些是相互关联的活动，不是一项神奇发明。

移动实验室使教学可以走出校园，但设计本身并不说明谁来参加、建议是否持续采用，或收入是否上升。农业知识也不只经由卡弗一人传播；教师、示范人员及农户都需要解释、调整。本条为示范车设计标注年代，塔斯基吉推广人员及后续计划的更广历史仍待进一步研究。

title.en: Tuskegee’s demonstration wagon · Agricultural science beyond the campus
title.zh: 塔斯基吉示范车 · 校园之外的农业科学

summary.en:
In 1906 George Washington Carver designed a mobile demonstration laboratory for Tuskegee’s agricultural teaching. The wagon addressed a practical problem: research centred on a college could not help poorer farmers simply by remaining on campus or circulating technical claims beyond their means. Demonstration offered another way to connect knowledge with cultivation and household work.

Tuskegee’s account places the wagon alongside free, plainly written brochures on crops, cultivation and nutritious meals. Farmers were encouraged to submit soil and water for analysis; instruction also addressed livestock care and preserving food. Alternatives to cotton, including legumes, connected decisions about crops to concerns about land and nutrition. These were related activities rather than a single miraculous invention.

The mobile laboratory made teaching portable, but its design alone does not establish who attended, how consistently advice was adopted or whether incomes rose. Nor was Carver the sole person through whom agricultural knowledge moved. Teachers, demonstrators and farming households had to interpret and adapt it. This entry dates the wagon’s design while leaving the wider history of Tuskegee’s extension staff and later programmes open for further research.

title.en: Liang: a southern court and Buddhist patronage
title.zh: 梁：南方朝廷与佛教赞助

location.label: Jiankang, present-day Nanjing; representative court location

summary.en:
The Liang dynasty continued the southern court sequence at Jiankang. Emperor Wu’s court supported scholarship, artists and Buddhist activity. The museum chronology records his Buddhist commitments and a mission to India for texts, placing the court within networks wider than the area it governed.

At the same time, northern politics changed from Northern Wei into competing eastern and western successor regimes. Liang therefore cannot stand for a single government across China. Compare the court’s religious and literary activity with northern Buddhist landscapes rather than treating the south as disconnected. The end of the dynasty also precedes the conquest of Chen: the beginning of Sui in 581 and southern reunification in 589 are separate milestones.
summary.zh:
梁延续以建康为中心的南方朝廷序列。梁武帝朝廷支持学术、艺术与佛教活动；博物馆年表还记载其佛教信仰以及赴印度求取经籍的活动，使南方朝廷置于超越辖境的联系网络中。

与此同时，北方从北魏转入东西两个继承体系，梁不能代表全中国的统一政府。可以把南方朝廷的宗教、文学活动与北方佛教景观并读，而非把南方视为隔绝世界。梁结束后还有陈；581年隋建立与589年征服陈，也是不同的历史节点。

dateNote.en: 502–557 is the museum dynastic span. The representative pin marks Jiankang; changing control during political turmoil is not reconstructed annually. Sui’s founding in 581 is not the date it conquered Chen.
dateNote.zh: 502—557年为博物馆采用的王朝时段。建康只是代表点，本条不逐年重建战乱中的地方控制。581年隋建国不等于隋征服陈的时间。

zh: 梁与北方多个继承政权同时存在。
佛教经籍交流把朝廷与南亚联系起来。

title.en: Zu Chongzhi: mathematics, calendars and court debate
title.zh: 祖冲之：数学、历法与朝廷争论

labelI18n.zh: 建康，代表性的朝廷地点

summary.en:
Zu Chongzhi worked on mathematical and astronomical problems in the southern dynasties. His Daming calendar proposed a 391-year cycle containing 144 intercalary months; its submission at court led to a dispute over observation and inherited practice. The calendar was not adopted during Emperor Xiaowu’s lifetime.

Later accounts also associate Zu with accurate approximations to pi, including 355/113, and with mechanical devices. His mathematical treatise survives through later descriptions rather than as a complete text, so the precise method behind the calculation cannot be reconstructed with confidence.
summary.zh:
祖冲之在南朝研究数学与天文历法。他提出的大明历采用391年144闰月的周期，上奏后引发朝廷对于观测与旧制的争论；孝武帝在世时该历未获施行。

后世记载还将圆周率的精密近似值，包括355/113，以及机械制作与祖冲之联系起来。他的数学著作并未完整传世，现存转述不足以可靠还原具体计算方法。

dateNote.en: Born 429. The Book of Southern Qi dates his death to Yongyuan 2 (500); the University of St Andrews gives 501. The 478 pin represents the 477–479 Shengming era, not an exact year.
dateNote.zh: 生于429年。《南齐书》记其卒于永元二年（500）；圣安德鲁斯大学资料列为501年。地图中的478年节点代表477—479年的升明年间，不是确定的具体年份。

rejected.reason: Qi is incidental in another person’s biography; manual not central to Zhang Juzheng’s reforms.

title.en: Zhang Juzheng: making revenue and official performance count
title.zh: 张居正：财政与官员执行的改革

summary.en: Zhang Juzheng entered the examination elite in 1547 and became chief grand secretary in 1572. His reform agenda joined court authority to information about land, taxes and the performance of officials. A land survey begun in 1578 sought to improve the state’s fiscal records; the Single Whip measures promoted in 1581 combined obligations and increased the role of payments in silver. Such changes depended on how local officers registered households and assessed demands, not simply on a decree from Beijing. Zhang also supported frontier commanders, including Qi Jiguang. His death in 1582 was followed by attacks on his position and family, showing how a program associated with one powerful minister could become vulnerable to a reversal at court.
summary.zh: 张居正1547年进士及第，1572年成为首辅。改革计划把朝廷权威与土地、税收和官员办事情况的信息联系起来。1578年开始的清丈力图改进财政记录，1581年推广的一条鞭措施合并赋役，并扩大白银缴纳的作用。这些改变取决于地方官怎样登记、核定征收，不能只靠北京一道命令。张氏还支持包括戚继光在内的边防将领。1582年去世后，其政治地位与家庭遭到打击，显示与一位强臣紧密相连的计划，如何容易受到朝廷翻转的影响。

dateNote.en: 1547–1582 follows examination through death. The 1578 and 1581 milestones date central initiatives, not uniform adoption in all districts or a claim that silver taxation began in 1581.
dateNote.zh: 1547—1582年从科举至卒年。1578、1581年指中央举措，不等于各县同步实行，也不表示白银纳税始于1581年。

title.en: 1949: a new government in Beijing
title.zh: 1949：北京宣布成立新政府

summary.en: Mao Zedong proclaimed the People’s Republic of China in Beijing after Communist victories in the civil war. The Nationalist government retreated to Taiwan, and the political division continued beyond the proclamation. Years of war, mobilization and competing programs of social change shaped the outcome. International recognition and alliances became part of the emerging Cold War. This entry marks a change of government and political order, not the beginning of Chinese society or a resolution of every territorial question. Comparing it with 1911 highlights how ending one regime and consolidating another can be separate historical processes.
summary.zh: 毛泽东在共产党取得内战优势后，于北京宣布中华人民共和国成立。国民党政府退至台湾，政治分裂并未随宣告而结束。长期战争、社会动员及不同社会改革方案共同塑造结果，国际承认与联盟也卷入冷战。本条目记录政权和政治秩序的转折，不将其视为中国社会的起点，也不暗示所有领土问题已获解决。

dateNote.en: The event year is 1949; the proclamation occurred on 1 October. The civil war and cross-strait division cannot be reduced to this single date.
dateNote.zh: 事件年份为1949年，宣告日期为10月1日；内战及海峡两岸分治不能压缩为单一日期。
